values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: 30 sites 'for tent, small trailer and large trailer use'; walk-in sites (parking a quarter mile SE of the main entrance) and a paddle-in/walk-in group-use area are extra. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/uppermanistee ('There are 30 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use.'; 'Parking for the walk-in sites is located a quarter mile southeast of the main campground entrance.'; 'There is a large group-use area near the river for paddle-in or walk-in camping.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (30 campsites), read 2026-10-25. The derived count 40 added walk-in sites the DNR does not count.

note: Rustic state forest campground among red pines and hardwoods along the Upper Manistee River, 7.7 mi SW of Frederic via County Road 612 and Goose Creek Road; a narrow footpath runs along the water's edge, with a staircase to the river mid-campground and a path by site #16. Separate walk-in tent sites (parked a quarter mile SE) and a paddle-in/walk-in group area. Brown, brook and rainbow trout. The reservable Manistee backcountry/canoe sites are a separate USFS program. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Season (year-round, roads not plowed) already manual and restated on the page, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian or an ORV camp (ORV 'no'). Directions carry no road warning.
